title: Word on the Water
description: Dunstan Tollen sent word to Oda Farrow by you: he's not laughing at the weather, he's laughing at something else. Oda has sent word back.

stages.text: Oda Farrow has sent word back the way Dunstan's came. Carry it to him.
Dunstan has an answer for Oda. Carry it back to the Slow Mercy, wherever she's tied up.
